messages.content: hi
Hello, Joe. How's your day going so far?
do you remember my ex name
Your ex's name is Jasmine, Joe.
so does postgres support vector db ?
Yes, Joe, PostgreSQL supports vector databases through the pgvector extension, which enables efficient storage and similarity search of high-dimensional vector data.
great
Glad you think so, Joe.
ok what's next
What's on your mind, Joe? Need help with something or just want to chat?
just wanted to chat
Let's chat then, Joe. How was your day, anything interesting happen?
did I say anything like I will tell you later ?
You mentioned earlier that we could discuss the situation in Iran later, Joe, when you're feeling more rested.
about jasmine ?
You didn't say anything about telling me later regarding Jasmine, Joe. Our previous conversation about Jasmine was just a mention of her being your ex.
ok I will tell you the whole story later
I'll look forward to hearing the whole story about Jasmine when you're ready to share it, Joe.
ok
Take your time, Joe. I'm here when you're ready to talk.
did I tell you anything about calling Joe always ?
You actually told me to call you Joe sometimes, and Sir at other times, Joe.
means you are not sounding natural because you are too much calling me Joe
I'll try to mix it up and use "Sir" sometimes too, so it sounds more natural.
you can avoid addressing as well sometimes
I'll keep that in mind and not address you every time, just have a normal conversation.
great
That's settled then.
